name: PostgreSQL High Availability
description: PostgreSQL streaming replication with automatic failover and HAProxy routing
readme:
# PostgreSQL High Availability

Companion template used to convert an existing PostgreSQL service (`haTemplateCode` of the `postgres` template). It is not deployed on its own.

- **root**: the existing service becomes the primary. Its data, volume and service ID are kept.
- **replica**: streaming replicas cloned with `pg_basebackup`, spread across Aven nodes.
- **edge**: HAProxy, the stable private endpoint. Connect with `${{<root>-ha.DATABASE_URL}}`.

The Aven control plane plays the coordinator role (instead of etcd/Patroni): it watches every node, promotes the most up-to-date replica when the primary is unreachable for 30 seconds and repoints HAProxy and the other replicas.

services.name: postgres

haConversionConfig.description: PostgreSQL 스트리밍 복제와 자동 failover. Aven 제어부가 주 노드를 감시하고, 주 노드가 30초 동안 응답하지 않으면 가장 최신인 replica를 승격합니다.

replica.label: Postgres replica
replica.description: 주 노드에서 스트리밍 복제하는 대기 노드입니다. 주 노드가 멈추면 승격됩니다.

edge.label: 리버스 프록시
edge.description: 현재 주 노드로 연결을 보내는 HAProxy replica입니다.

services.start_command:
set -eu
export PGDATA="${PGDATA:-/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata}"
ROLE="${AVEN_HA_ROLE:-primary}"
PRIMARY="${AVEN_HA_PRIMARY:-}"
asuser() { if command -v su-exec >/dev/null 2>&1; then su-exec postgres "$@"; else gosu postgres "$@"; fi; }
PASSFILE=/tmp/keel-ha.pgpass
printf '*:*:*:%s:%s\n' "$PGUSER" "$(printf '%s' "$PGPASSWORD" | sed 's/[\\:]/\\&/g')" > "$PASSFILE"
chown postgres "$PASSFILE"
chmod 600 "$PASSFILE"
export PGPASSFILE="$PASSFILE"
if [ "$ROLE" = replica ]; then
  [ -n "$PRIMARY" ] || { echo "keel-ha: AVEN_HA_PRIMARY is empty" >&2; exit 1; }
  if [ -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ] && [ ! -f "$PGDATA/standby.signal" ]; then
    if [ "${AVEN_HA_REJOIN:-reclone}" = standby ]; then
      echo "keel-ha: rejoining as a standby of $PRIMARY"
      asuser touch "$PGDATA/standby.signal"
    else
      OLD="$PGDATA.demoted-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
      echo "keel-ha: this node was a primary; keeping its data in $OLD and cloning $PRIMARY"
      mv "$PGDATA" "$OLD"
    fi
  fi
  if [ ! -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$PGDATA"
    chown postgres:postgres "$PGDATA"
    chmod 700 "$PGDATA"
    until asuser pg_basebackup -h "$PRIMARY" -p 5432 -U "$PGUSER" -D "$PGDATA" -X stream -c fast -R -w; do
      echo "keel-ha: waiting for primary $PRIMARY"
      find "$PGDATA" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
      sleep 5
    done
  fi
  exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c hot_standby=on -c wal_keep_size=1GB -c "primary_conninfo=host=$PRIMARY port=5432 user=$PGUSER passfile=$PASSFILE application_name=$AVEN_SERVICE_NAME"
fi
if [ -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  rm -f "$PGDATA/standby.signal"
  grep -qs '^host replication all all' "$PGDATA/pg_hba.conf" || echo 'host replication all all md5' >> "$PGDATA/pg_hba.conf"
fi
exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c wal_keep_size=1GB

services.name: postgres-ha
services.start_command:
set -eu
CFG=/tmp/haproxy.cfg
{
  printf 'global
  maxconn 10000
  log stdout format raw local0 notice
'
  printf 'resolvers aven
  parse-resolv-conf
  hold valid 5s
  hold obsolete 5s
'
  printf 'defaults
  mode tcp
  log global
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 1h
  timeout server 1h
'
  printf '  default-server init-addr last,libc,none resolvers aven check inter 2s fall 2 rise 1 on-marked-down shutdown-sessions
'
  printf 'frontend postgres
  bind :5432
  default_backend primary
'
  printf 'backend primary
'
  i=0
  for n in $(printf '%s' "${AVEN_HA_NODES:-}" | tr ',' ' '); do i=$((i+1)); printf '  server node%s %s
' "$i" "$n"; done
} > "$CFG"
exec haproxy -W -db -f "$CFG"
